description: The plot, titled "ReDial", illustrates the performance of different models across a range of discrete values using two different evaluation metrics. The x-axis lacks a specific text label but displays a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with a tick label interval of 1. The plot features dual y-axes: the left y-axis is labeled "Recall@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.30 to 0.60 and a tick label interval of 0.05, while the right y-axis is labeled "NDCG@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.15 to 0.22 and a tick label interval of 0.01. Four lines are displayed in the plot area. Plotted against the left y-axis is a green solid line with circle markers, labeled "Recall@50 (Ours)", which starts at approximately 0.35 at x=1, rises to about 0.43 at x=2, and continues to increase more gradually to end at roughly 0.49 at x=5. Also corresponding to the left y-axis is a green dotted line without markers (its legend label is obscured by a grey rectangle), which maintains a steady, constant horizontal trend at a value of approximately 0.47 from x=1 to x=5. Plotted against the right y-axis is a blue solid line with square markers, labeled "NDCG@50 (Ours)", which begins at approximately 0.157 at x=1, increases to about 0.177 at x=2, rises to roughly 0.188 at x=4, and remains steady at 0.188 at x=5. Finally, a blue dotted line without markers, labeled "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)", corresponds to the right y-axis and maintains a constant horizontal trend at a value of approximately 0.155 across the entire x-axis range.
